TITLE: Observations on the Color of Late Afternoon
TEXT:
Late afternoon is the color of almost.
Almost done.
Almost forgiven.
Almost brave.

The light arrives sideways,
as if it is trying not to disturb you.

In that light:
- dust becomes visible (honest)
- edges soften (merciful)
- your to-do list looks like a suggestion

If you can, stand still.
Let the day pass through you
without collecting a toll.
Call it practice.
